_about.order: As on media kit page 3 (PARCERIAS), left to right, top to bottom.
_about.logos: All logos are solid black (#000) on transparent. SVG has a tight viewBox; PNG is 240px tall incl. 8px padding.
_about.aspect: width / height of the logo artwork (tight bounds).
_about.scale: Suggested display HEIGHT multiplier for optical balance: rendered height = baseHeight * scale (e.g. baseHeight 64px desktop, 44px mobile). Already capped so width <= 2.6 * baseHeight. Derived from aspect and ink density, then hand-tuned after visual review (lab/logos.html).
_about.ink: Fraction of the logo bounding box covered by ink (0-1); used for scale.
_about.method: official-svg = brand/Wikimedia vector recoloured; logo-repo-svg = vector from a logo repository; web-png-traced = official raster from brand site, traced to vector; canva-crop-traced = cropped from the 9x export of the media kit and traced (potrace).
_about.source_url: Where the delivered artwork came from (canva:// = cropped from the media kit export). website = brand site when known but not used as the artwork source.
_about.confidence: Confidence in the brand IDENTITY (name/what it is). See docs/logos.md for items needing client confirmation.
